channel.title: Utility Dive - Latest News
channel.description: Utility industry news and analysis for energy professionals.

item.title: What is holding back bidirectional EV charging as a grid resource?
item.description: Costs remain high and tech solutions are incomplete, but experts say careful utility program design and a new generation of vehicle charging solutions will bring value to both consumers and the grid.
item.dc:creator: Brian Martucci

item.title: Bright Horizon utility lands Microsoft data center deals amid Wyoming buildout
item.description: Cheyenne Light — with a 439-MW peak load record — is working on a 3-GW near-term data center pipeline, with an additional 2.5 GW in emerging opportunities, per company officials.
item.dc:creator: Ethan Howland

item.title: 2026 Q3 earnings roundup: Utilities seek to reassure investors amid election fallout
item.description: Executives went from touting data center pipelines to emphasizing the diversity of sources driving load growth, their shared concern over energy affordability and good relations with incoming officials.
item.dc:creator: Meris Lutz

item.title: FirstEnergy utilities get approval for $2.5B gas plant in West Virginia
item.description: Consumer advocates and environmental groups opposed the project, citing concerns over load growth projections and shifting of project risk to ratepayers.
item.dc:creator: Charles Paullin

item.title: TVA touts $1.7B data center deal under new large-load tariff
item.description: Separately, the utility recently received the first small modular reactor construction permit from the NRC for a BWRX-300 reactor at the Clinch River Site in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, but it has “not yet decided” whether to build it.
item.dc:creator: Diana DiGangi
